policy.unit_quarantine_release: Requires documented review; no automatic release merely because the quote returns to a previous scale.
policy.zero_volume: Retain as reported activity; it is neither a confirmed suspension nor proof of erroneous prices. Trading eligibility will use trailing activity, not full-history percentages.
policy.ohlc_inconsistency: Retain as a diagnostic. Open or close outside daily high-low is common in this vendor feed; high-low fields must not be used for fill/stop simulation without further verification.
policy.held_missing_prices: Future portfolio code must retain the holding and stop/resolve an unpriceable valuation or order. Never assume cash, a zero return, or a successful exit.
policy.stage: Data preparation only; no signals, liquidity thresholds, performance selection, or train/holdout split.
